About these 18 rides

There’s a ride every day of the week; Sunday has the most, with 6. The earliest start is GABA El Tour de Tucson Training Rides at 6:45 am; the latest is Tuesday Night Ride (TNR) at 8:45 pm. After work, 4 roll on a weekday evening. The group waits for everyone on 4 of them (no-drop), and beginners are welcome on 2. There’s one ride made for LGBTQ+ riders, 2 for women, trans and femme riders, 1 for BIPOC riders and 1 for families. Each one was checked at its source between Sep 15 and Nov 9, 2026.
